{{Short description|Construction for simplicial sets}}
In [[higher category theory]] in [[mathematics]], the '''diamond operation''' of [[Simplicial set|simplicial sets]] is an [[Operation (mathematics)|operation]] taking two simplicial sets to construct another simplicial set. It is closely related to the [[Join (simplicial sets)|join of simplicial sets]] and used in an alternative construction of the [[Twisted diagonal (simplicial sets)|twisted diagonal]].

== Definition ==
[[File:Join.svg|thumb|Visualization of the diamond <math>X\diamond Y</math> with the blue part representing <math>X</math> and the green part representing <math>Y</math>.]]
For simplicial set <math>X</math> and <math>Y</math>, their ''diamond'' <math>X\diamond Y</math> is the [[Pushout (category theory)|pushout]] of the diagram:<ref>Lurie 2009, Definition 4.2.1.1</ref><ref>Cisinksi 2019, 4.2.1.</ref>

: <math>X\times Y\times\Delta^1\leftarrow X\times Y\times\partial\Delta^1\rightarrow X+Y.</math>

One has a canonical map <math>X\diamond Y\rightarrow\Delta^0\diamond\Delta^0
\cong\Delta^1</math> for which the fiber of <math>0</math> is <math>X</math> and the fiber of <math>1</math> is <math>Y</math>.

== Right adjoints ==
Let <math>Y</math> be a simplicial set. The functor <math>Y\diamond -\colon
\mathbf{sSet}\rightarrow Y\backslash\mathbf{sSet},
X\mapsto(Y\mapsto X\diamond Y)</math> has a [[right adjoint]] <math>Y\backslash\mathbf{sSet}\rightarrow\mathbf{sSet},
(t\colon Y\rightarrow W)\mapsto t\backslash\backslash W</math> (alternatively denoted <math>Y\backslash\backslash W</math>) and the functor <math>-\diamond Y\colon
\mathbf{sSet}\rightarrow Y\backslash\mathbf{sSet},
X\mapsto(Y\mapsto X\diamond Y)</math> has a right adjoint <math>Y\backslash\mathbf{sSet}\rightarrow\mathbf{sSet},
(t\colon Y\rightarrow W)\mapsto W//t</math> (alternatively denoted <math>W//Y</math>).<ref>Lurie 2009, after Corollary 4.2.1.4.</ref><ref>Cisinski 2019, 4.2.1.</ref> A special case is <math>Y=\Delta^0</math> the [[Terminal object|terminal]] simplicial set, since <math>\mathbf{sSet}_*
=\Delta^0\backslash\mathbf{sSet}</math> is the category of pointed simplicial sets.

== Properties ==

* For simplicial sets <math>X</math> and <math>Y</math>, there is a unique morphism <math>\gamma_{X,Y}\colon
X\diamond Y\rightarrow X*Y</math> from the [[Join (simplicial sets)|join of simplicial sets]] compatible with the maps <math>X+Y\rightarrow X*Y,X\diamond Y</math> and <math>X*Y,X\diamond Y\rightarrow\Delta^1</math>.<ref name=":0">Cisinski 2019, Proposition 4.2.2.</ref> It is a weak categorical equivalence, hence a weak equivalence of the [[Joyal model structure]].<ref name=":5">Lurie 2009, Proposition 4.2.1.2.</ref><ref name=":2">Cisinksi 2019,  Proposition 4.2.3.</ref>
* For a simplicial set <math>X</math>, the functors <math>X\diamond -,-\diamond X\colon\mathbf{sSet}\rightarrow\mathbf{sSet}</math> preserve weak categorical equivalences.<ref>Lurie 2009, Corollary 4.2.1.3.</ref><ref>Cisinski 2019, Proposition 4.2.4.</ref>
